layman_headline: All three positions are treading water — no new opportunities worth chasing right now.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful, sideways mood with Bitcoin down about 3% on the week and altcoins struggling under high Bitcoin dominance. Our three open trades (SOL, LINK, FET) are all near their entry prices — slightly down on SOL and LINK, barely positive on FET. None of the new candidates on the watchlist present a clean, low-risk entry: the ones that have pumped hard (AKE, VELVET, H) are overextended, and the rest lack enough technical data to build conviction.
layman_action: Hold your current positions and be patient. All three trades are within normal ranges and haven't hit stop-losses or targets. Wait for a clearer setup before adding risk.
expert_reasoning: The portfolio is fully deployed with three active swing trades. SOL (-1.3%), LINK (-1.0%), and FET (+0.2%) are all within normal fluctuation bands and well above their stop-losses. Among swing candidates, AKE (RSI 92) and VELVET (+128% in 7d) are dangerously overextended. INJ, TRUMP, WLD, H, and SOL lack RSI/MACD data making conviction entries impossible. BTC dominance at 56.2% continues to suppress altcoin performance. The Fear & Greed index at 34 is improving from a weekly average of 30.3, which is a mildly positive sign but not actionable yet. With high BTC dominance and a fearful market, this is not the environment to add more altcoin exposure without a strong catalyst.

Fear & Greed index trajectory — if it continues improving toward 40+ it could support alt recovery
FET RSI movement — if it dips below 30 it becomes a stronger conviction hold; above 50 signals momentum shift toward target
market_context: Crypto markets are in a cautious consolidation phase with BTC at $63K, down 3.2% weekly. High BTC dominance (56.2%) and Fear sentiment (34) suggest capital is defensive and concentrated in Bitcoin, making altcoin swing trades higher risk.
context_banner: Three positions active in a fearful, BTC-dominant market — patience is the optimal strategy until sentiment or technicals shift decisively.

FET RSI at 39 is approaching oversold, supporting the hold thesis; AKE at 92 is extremely overbought and was correctly avoided.
